requirements.text: The contractor shall execute and complete the following principal components, in accordance with the drawings, technical specifications and bill of quantities issued with this tender:

The works shall be executed on a construct-only basis against the Employer's issued-for-construction drawings, except for the refrigeration plant and the pre-engineered steel building, for which the contractor shall provide detailed shop drawings and design calculations, prepared and stamped by a professional engineer registered with the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC), for the Employer's approval prior to fabrication.
The entire works shall be completed and handed over, tested and commissioned, within fourteen (14) months from the date of the Engineer's notice to commence.
A detailed construction programme in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project format shall be submitted within fourteen (14) days of the notice to commence and shall be updated monthly.

All materials shall conform to the technical specifications and to the relevant Pakistan Standards or, where no Pakistan Standard exists, to the applicable British or ASTM standards named in the specifications.

Structural concrete shall be batched at an approved plant with cube testing at a site laboratory; reinforcement steel shall be Grade 60 deformed bars from an approved mill with mill test certificates for every consignment.
PUF insulated panels shall carry factory test certificates for density, thermal conductivity and fire classification.

The contractor shall submit material approval requests, with samples where required, at least fourteen (14) days before intended use, and no material shall be incorporated in the works without the Engineer's written approval.
Bidders must satisfy all of the following mandatory requirements.
Non-compliance with any requirement shall render the bid non-responsive:

EC-1: The bidder must hold a valid constructor licence issued by the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) in category C-2 or above, with the licence valid for the year 2026 and covering the relevant specialisation codes (CE-01 civil works and ME-05 HVACR). PEC licence category C-2 is mandatory; bids submitted by firms licensed below category C-2 shall be rejected.

EC-2: The bidder must be registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan or the Registrar of Firms, and with the Federal Board of Revenue (NTN and STRN), and must appear on the Active Taxpayers List.

EC-3: The bidder must have completed, within the last eight (8) years, at least two (2) industrial or warehouse construction projects each of contract value not less than PKR 250 million, of which at least one must have included cold storage or industrial refrigeration works. Completion certificates from the employers concerned must be enclosed.
EC-4: The bidder must have an average annual construction turnover of not less than PKR 400 million over the last three (3) audited financial years, supported by audited financial statements.

EC-5: The bidder must demonstrate access to liquid assets or unconditional credit lines of not less than PKR 80 million, supported by a bank certificate issued not earlier than thirty (30) days before the bid submission deadline.
EC-6: The bidder must submit an affidavit that it is not blacklisted or debarred by any federal, provincial or local government department, autonomous body or public sector organisation in Pakistan.
EC-7: The bidder must furnish bid security equal to three percent (3%) of the bid price in the form of a bank guarantee or pay order from a scheduled bank of Pakistan.

EC-8: The bidder shall deploy a full-time site agent who is a PEC-registered professional civil engineer with at least ten (10) years of post-registration experience in industrial building construction, supported by a PEC-registered mechanical engineer with at least seven (7) years of experience in refrigeration and HVAC installations. CVs, PEC registration numbers and undertakings of availability must be submitted with the bid.
EC-9: The bidder must have a documented health, safety and environment (HSE) management system;
ISO 45001 certification or an equivalent third-party-audited HSE system is mandatory.

The contractor shall implement a site-specific HSE plan, which must be submitted within fourteen (14) days of the notice to commence and approved by the Engineer before mobilisation of major plant.

The HSE plan shall address, at a minimum: scaffolding and work at height; lifting operations and crane management; confined space entry; ammonia handling and refrigerant safety during charging and commissioning; hot works and welding; electrical safety and lock-out tag-out; dust and noise control; waste management; and emergency response.

The contractor shall deploy a full-time qualified HSE officer for the duration of the works, shall conduct daily toolbox talks, and shall report all incidents, including near misses, within twenty-four (24) hours.
The Employer operates a zero-fatality policy; any fatal accident attributable to contractor negligence shall constitute grounds for termination.
All workers shall be provided with personal protective equipment and shall be covered under workmen's compensation insurance.
Monthly HSE statistics shall be appended to each interim payment certificate.
Bids shall first be screened against the mandatory eligibility criteria in Section 3.

The lowest evaluated bid price shall receive the full 35 points; other bids shall receive points in inverse proportion to their evaluated price.

draft.title: Relevant Experience & Past Performance
draft.content:
**Punjab Citizen Facilitation Portal & Mobile App** [CAP-001] — Provincial Information Technology Board (Punjab) (Government), 2021, USD 950k, 24 months.
Designed, developed and operated a bilingual Urdu/English citizen e-services portal and Android/iOS app offering 64 online services including domicile, birth certificates and fee payments. The portal meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines, integrates NADRA CNIC verification and 1Link/easypaisa e-payments, and runs on a load-balanced Kubernetes cluster with 99.9% uptime SLA. A PMP-led PMO managed delivery across 12 departments, with end-user training and capacity building for 400+ government staff. _Outcome: 3.2 million citizen accounts in 18 months; average service turnaround cut from 9 days to 48 hours; 78% of applications now submitted online._

**Land Records Digitization & Management Information System** [CAP-002] — Provincial Board of Revenue (Sindh) (Government), 2019, USD 1400k, 36 months.
Digitized 14.6 million rural land record documents (registers haqdaran-e-zameen, mutations, fard) using high-speed scanning, Urdu OCR and double-blind data entry, then built the land records MIS with cadastral GIS mapping and service-center workflow for certified fard issuance and mutation processing. Implemented role-based access, biometric verification of applicants and a full audit trail aligned with ISO 27001 controls. Delivered training and capacity building for 600 revenue officials across 24 districts. _Outcome: Mutation processing time reduced from 45 days to 7 days; 99.2% scanning accuracy verified by third-party audit; over 5 million certified land record copies issued digitally._

**Provincial e-Procurement Platform (e-Tendering & Supplier Registration)** [CAP-003] — Provincial Public Procurement Regulatory Authority (Government), 2022, USD 1100k, 30 months.
Built and rolled out an end-to-end e-procurement platform covering supplier registration, e-tendering, online bid submission with PKI digital signatures and encryption, two-envelope bid evaluation workflows, contract award publication and grievance handling. The system enforces procurement rules engines per PPRA regulations and produces complete audit logs for accountability bodies. Operated a 24/7 bidder helpdesk with bilingual Urdu/English support and ran capacity-building workshops for 1,800 suppliers and 350 procuring-entity officers. _Outcome: 4,100 tenders processed worth USD 700M in first two years; average tender cycle shortened by 31%; supplier participation per tender up from 3.1 to 5.8 bids._

**Civil Registration & Vital Statistics (CRVS) System** [CAP-004] — Local Government & Community Development Department (Government), 2018, USD 700k, 24 months.
Implemented a province-wide civil registration system for birth, death, marriage and divorce events with union-council level data entry, NADRA integration for CNIC-linked family records and an offline-capable Android field app for registrars in low-connectivity areas. Included automated certificate printing with QR-code verification and statistical dashboards for health and planning departments. Conducted train-the-trainer programs reaching 2,400 union council secretaries. _Outcome: Birth registration coverage rose from 34% to 71% in three years; certificate issuance time cut from 15 days to same-day at 3,400 union councils._

**Driving License Issuance & Management System** [CAP-005] — Provincial Traffic Police Department (Government), 2020, USD 520k, 18 months.
Delivered a license management system covering learner permits, driving tests, license issuance, renewals and duplicates across 28 licensing centers, with biometric capture (fingerprint and facial photo), NADRA verification and secure card personalization integration. Citizens book appointments and pay fees online through a bilingual Urdu/English portal; an e-challan interface flags unpaid violations before renewal. Provided 24/7 application support under a 99.5% availability SLA. _Outcome: License issuance time reduced from 12 days to 3 days; 1.1 million licenses processed; counter fraud incidents down 85% after biometric rollout._

**Online Tax Filing & Revenue Collection Portal** [CAP-006] — Provincial Revenue Authority (Government), 2023, USD 880k, 22 months.
Replaced manual sales-tax-on-services filing with an online portal for taxpayer registration, e-filing of monthly returns, e-payments via 1Link/ADC channels and risk-based audit case selection. Built taxpayer ledgers, withholding statements, refund workflows and a business-intelligence layer for revenue forecasting. The platform passed an independent VAPT, operates under ISO 27001-aligned ISMS controls, and is supported by a 24/7 bilingual helpdesk with a 99.9% uptime SLA during filing windows. _Outcome: Registered taxpayer base grew 42%; on-time filing compliance improved from 61% to 88%; collections increased 27% year-on-year after launch._
